name: checkout-api
description: Core orchestration API serving web and mobile checkout flows, coordinating pricing, fraud checks, and payment authorization.

name: pricing-service
description: Computes real-time cart pricing, promotions, currency conversions, and taxes with Redis L1 caching.

name: fraud-service
description: Calculates real-time transaction risk scores (0-100) using ML models and velocity rule evaluation.

name: payment-gateway-adapter
description: Translates internal payment capture/authorization calls to external acquirers (Stripe, Adyen) with idempotent request keys.

name: order-db-proxy
description: Connection pooler and sharding router in front of PostgreSQL order clusters.

name: notification-worker
description: Asynchronous consumer processing order receipt emails and SMS confirmations via Kafka topics.
